description: Header file defining inline functions and includes for PyTorch's ATen library, focusing on tensor operations and operator dependencies.

methods.name: var
methods.description: Inline overload for tensor variance with specified dimension.

methods.name: var_mean
methods.description: Inline overload for tensor variance and mean with specified dimension.

methods.name: std
methods.description: Inline overload for tensor standard deviation with specified dimension.

methods.name: std_mean
methods.description: Inline overload for tensor standard deviation and mean with specified dimension.

methods.name: numel
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the tensor.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the tensor along a given dimension.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of the tensor along a given dimension.

methods.name: is_complex
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is complex.

methods.name: is_floating_point
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is of a floating point type.

methods.name: is_signed
methods.description: Checks if the tensor has a signed data type.

methods.name: is_inference
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is in inference mode.

methods.name: _is_zerotensor
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is a zero tensor.

methods.name: is_conj
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is conjugated.

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of the tensor.

methods.name: is_neg
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is negative.
